title: Serve the complete European fixed-size literal byte-copy bank
changes: Extend e342-d341 with the E568 residual of 526 payload bytes across 91 ranges and 97 literal words. Reuse shared physical sources and preserve e341 packet compatibility and non-owned bytes.
validation: Windows build xwc6z8ye and Wine e569-fixed-byte-copies-wine-77d8ytdh PASS. All 99 affected original Thumb calls use the extracted sources with altered backing, making 591 typed requests. The copied destination, full state and clock match every reference. All 2,256 mirror boundary checks and both raw gaps pass. e341 attaches and a relabeled incomplete e342 candidate is rejected transactionally. Thirteen input guards pass and Wine drains.
limitations: Standard e342 CLI verification, reuse and first creation, generated and ordinary calls, other source/count setups, indirect calls, original BIOS, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
